She carves out daily \"me-time\" for activities like running, reading, playing violin, pottery, and painting, which refresh and de-stress her. Pottery serves as a form of therapy and self-expression, providing joy and emotional release. She values creativity, mental health, family bonding, and nature, often engaging in family camping trips that bring peace and connection. Despite setbacks like an injury, Melanie maintains her self-care routine through alternative creative outlets such as painting. Self-care improves her mental health and headspace, helping her stay present and resilient, supported by the strength she draws from her family.
